# E0437: `unsafe` with no reason

An `unsafe` block's reason says why its code is sound, and `stilt show` prints it beside the block. Write the reason.

- Rule: [`c.unsafe-because`](../../reference/20-builds.md#c.unsafe-because)
- Reported at: the reason.
- Tier: `systems`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0437:6
use std.c

extern fn strlen(s: c.Str) -> u64

pub fn length(text: str) -> u64 {
  unsafe because " " { text.with_c_str(|s| strlen(s)) }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
use std.c

extern fn strlen(s: c.Str) -> u64

pub fn length(text: str) -> u64 {
  unsafe because "with_c_str ends s with a NUL" { text.with_c_str(|s| strlen(s)) }
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0437_unsafe_with_no_reason.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0437_unsafe_with_no_reason.lt):

```text
── `unsafe` WITH NO REASON ──────── E0437_unsafe_with_no_reason.lt:6:18  [E0437]

This `unsafe` block gives no reason; say why its code is sound:

  6 │   unsafe because " " { text.with_c_str(|s| strlen(s)) }
    │                  ^^^

An `unsafe` block's reason says why its code is sound, and `stilt show` prints
it beside the block. Write the reason.
```
